_comment: Campaign map rules (#275). Every number is a TODO(initiator) assumption. `columns`: how many star systems each column holds, left to right; the first column is the start harbour; every system links forward to `forward` systems of the next column, so every column after the first holds at least `forward[0]`, which makes 7 the least total of 4 columns. The last column is where the map ends (0.1 has no goal). `danger` is a rough level 0 to 5 for the map to show later.
